gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-carian: Neon looks marker-drawn, with plain, glowing characters and open spacing between every pair of glyphs. Noto Sans Carian is the clean sans-serif foil, its terminals parting like open scissor blades.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Vibrant and glowing, Neon keeps its crossbars exactly as thick as its stems, with tall lowercase like stamped metal type. Noto Sans Chakma packs its lowercase up toward the caps.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-cham: Neon's strokes look cut from wire, glowing and uniform, with tall stamped-metal lowercase and open spacing. Over a longer page, Noto Sans Cham feels modern and clean, its rounded lowercase and open c shapes letting the eye glide along.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Glowing wire-bright outlines, all one width, easy to trace with a finger. Noto Sans Cherokee then settles into a tall band of letters under short stalks, its e leaving a wide gap at the terminal.
